answer: Key the bond to a hardware root of trust and split its custody across three independent auditors. Log each attestation with a monotonic counter so a duplicate is caught by replay, not by name. Measure the hollow: 1,000 identities need 1,000 distinct roots, and a virtual root costs one forged attestation that the replay check rejects. Rotate auditors every epoch. The prism splits one bond into three views, so no single auditor sees the whole key, and a gale of registrations cannot reuse a root already seen.
